notes.title: Development update on the Shaola series
notes.notes:
It's been a long 2020! I thought now would be a good time for a development update since it's a brand new year and it's been awhile.

We all know 2020 was a tough year. We were hit with setbacks and development was stalled, but it's a brand new year and we're coming back in full force!

We're currently working on [i]Mysteries of Shaola: The Cave[/i]. It is a new chronicle of Shaola where you become Ice of Zuda Kingdom, the legendary investigator, one of the Magnificent Five. You fight through Kazen Kingdom and uncover the truth of the mysterious cave, discover dirty secrets, add to your legend, and ultimately confront the "evil" force. This role-playing game blends the genres of fantasy and mystery.

I have really enjoyed testing the game so far, and if you enjoyed [i]Heroes of Shaola[/i] for the characters and story, you'll definitely enjoy this one as well.

Also, as I'm making trailers for the new game, I made two for [i]Heroes of Shaola[/i] as well. I hope you enjoy watching them.

Eric

notes.title: Update 2.1
notes.notes:
Version 2.1 is live! This minor update enhances some graphics and sound effects, with a few additional bug-fixes.

[list]
[*] Graphics and sound effects enhancement
[*] Background music on ending scenes have been modified
[*] All known glitches/exploits on events and cutscenes have been fixed
[/list]

If there are any bugs left, please let us know, we'll try to fix them ASAP. Thanks for your support and I hope you'll enjoy Heroes of Shaola and our upcoming titles as well. :)

notes.title: Update 2.0
notes.notes:
Changes in version 2.0:

[list]
[*] All passability errors in forests and jungle have been fixed.
[*] Some Anger skills animation have been improved.
[*] Some graphics, character sets have been upgraded to F8 with smoother movement.
[*] Several modification on quests instruction, presentation and dialogues.
[*] More realistic time frame while substituting during battle. 
[*] More experience and rewards for battles in Zalumi.
[*] All known bugs have been fixed.
[/list]

After this update, we will shift our focus to complete the upcoming title in the Shaola series.

Steam community is the most important to us, we are still going to follow up closely for your feedback on Heroes of Shaola. :)

notes.title: Update 1.7, balance and statistic
notes.notes:
Changes in version 1.7:

[list]
[*] Major changes to balance in the early parts of the game.
[*] Major changes to bandits, common orcs and the haunted mushrooms statistic.

notes.title: Update 1.5, river sound effects and atmospheric factors
notes.notes:
Changes in version 1.5:
[list]
[*] Minor changes to balance and statistic.
[*] Minor changes to characters relationship, interaction, text and dialogues.
[*] River sound effects and several atmospheric factors have been added.
[*] Several cut-scenes have been improved.
[*] A few more direction pointers have been added.
[*] The bug where the game crashes a few times if the player use F12 to reset the game have been fixed.
[*] A few minor bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.2.5
notes.notes:
Changes in version 1.2.5:

[list][*] More user-friendly to casual players and non-RPG gamers.
[*] Arrow pointers have been added to a selection of outdoor maps, so that it is clearer on where to go to advance the story (*).
[*] Minor balancing to gameplay and battles.
[*] Further enhancement to scenes and dialogues.
[*] Minor revising to the relationship and interaction between characters. 
[*] Tutorial and instruction have been modified with more specific details.
[*] Sound effect have been improved, minor modification to music effect during important scenes or character’s reaction.
[*] A few story scenes and plots have been enhanced to bring each character to life.
[*] 2 minor tile issues have been fixed.
[*] Minor changes to a few items, weapons and armors.
[*] NPC dialogues have been enhanced.[/list]
* [i]In a certain parts of the game, arrow pointers won’t appear if they affect the fun of exploration. It is recommended that you don’t depend too much on the pointers. Don’t miss out on hidden areas and loot.[/i]
